hematology-h20.title: 感染共同语言
hematology-h20.first_pass_focus: 以病原—部位—宿主—反应—源控制五问建立感染共同语言，药物与机械源控分开。
hematology-h20.stop_line: 不补完整微生物学/抗菌药理/感染内科。
hematology-h20.recall_spine: 感染五问 → 感染分类语言 → 治疗与证据 → 器官 owner、局部/全身分流与最终算法

c-h20-lg01.label: 感染五问：病原—空间—宿主—反应—源控制
c-h20-lg01.goal: distinguish pathogen presence from invasion, combine real anatomical space with host defense and tissue-reaction pattern, and keep weak host reaction from being mistaken for mild infection.
c-h20-lg01.closure: from a febrile/local lesion case, identify the true infection space, host state and expected tissue reaction before naming a disease or drug.
c-h20-lg01.continuity_rationale: these four KPs form the common infection model and the five major tissue-response categories.

c-h20-lg02.label: 感染分类语言：混合、特异、机会、二重
c-h20-lg02.goal: separate mixed infection and course labels from specific infection, opportunity infection and antibiotic-selection-driven superinfection.
c-h20-lg02.closure: distinguish “host became permissive” from “broad antibiotics selected replacement flora” and avoid treating the Source examples as a complete pathogen curriculum.
c-h20-lg02.continuity_rationale: these are naming categories answering different causal questions; learning them together is safer than memorizing labels independently.

c-h20-lg03.label: 治疗与证据：抗菌药、源控制、预防/联合用药、取样空间
c-h20-lg03.goal: keep drug action separate from mechanical source control, preserve Current Source prophylaxis/combination precision, and choose specimens that match the suspected infection space.
c-h20-lg03.closure: for a surgical infection scenario, decide whether antimicrobials are indicated, whether source control is non-substitutable and where the sample should come from; use Source-specific timing only when the question calls for it.
c-h20-lg03.continuity_rationale: these KPs form one action/evidence layer after the infection has been localized.

c-h20-lg04.label: 器官 owner、局部/全身分流与最终算法
c-h20-lg04.goal: return organ infections to A/B/D/E owners, distinguish local infection from systemic danger without relying on fever/WBC alone, and route to H21–H26.
c-h20-lg04.closure: execute entry → space → host → reaction → source → owner / severity route and state when the case must leave H20 for H25 or H26.
c-h20-lg04.continuity_rationale: these are the Block exit and ownership guards.

hematology-h21.title: 结核跨器官整合
hematology-h21.first_pass_focus: 只做TB共同病理、原发/继发/播散与跨器官路由，不重复肺/肾/肠等器官治疗。
hematology-h21.stop_line: 不重复R7或A3/B/D等器官结核诊疗。
hematology-h21.recall_spine: TB共同病理 → 原发/继发/HIV宿主 → 肺外器官地图 → 肉芽肿鉴别 + TB跨器官反向算法

c-h21-lg01.label: TB共同病理：控制病原也制造干酪坏死
c-h21-lg01.goal: connect cell-mediated containment and delayed injury to granuloma/caseation and retain the Source cell-wall-component precision only as bounded explanatory detail.
c-h21-lg01.closure: reconstruct a tuberculous granuloma and explain why granuloma formation and tissue destruction coexist.
c-h21-lg01.continuity_rationale: immune logic, Source bacterial-component interface and histologic granuloma are one shared TB model.

c-h21-lg02.label: 原发 / 继发 / HIV宿主：免疫背景决定播散与形态
c-h21-lg02.goal: compare primary lymphohematogenous spread, secondary bronchogenic/localized cavitary disease, cavity–shedding relation, hematogenous/miliary spread and immunodeficient atypical TB.
c-h21-lg02.closure: given host/background/location/cavity/lymph-node clues, identify the likely host-state pattern and predicted spread route without re-teaching R7 treatment.
c-h21-lg02.continuity_rationale: these five KPs are one host–spread movie.

c-h21-lg03.label: 肺外器官地图：解释传播，诊疗回 owner
c-h21-lg03.goal: route renal/genitourinary, intestinal/peritoneal, CNS/nodal/female-reproductive/bone-joint TB by likely spread and canonical owner.
c-h21-lg03.closure: from an extra-pulmonary TB clue, explain the propagation path and name the correct Primary owner rather than expanding a second organ-specific clinical model.
c-h21-lg03.continuity_rationale: these three KPs are the cross-organ ownership map.

c-h21-lg04.label: 肉芽肿鉴别 + TB跨器官反向算法
c-h21-lg04.goal: distinguish TB from chronic schistosomal granuloma and syphilitic gumma, then execute host → spread → organ → owner.
c-h21-lg04.closure: solve a granulomatous multi-organ vignette without duplicating any existing TB Primary or using “granuloma” as a disease label.
c-h21-lg04.continuity_rationale: the comparison is the falsification test for the final routing algorithm.

hematology-h22.title: 流脑与乙脑
hematology-h22.first_pass_focus: 用脑膜空间化脓 vs 脑实质变质区分流脑/乙脑，并把完整神经管理后置。
hematology-h22.stop_line: 不扩完整神经感染临床管理。
hematology-h22.recall_spine: 流脑 → 乙脑 → 流脑 vs 乙脑 vs 结脑最终分流

c-h22-lg01.label: 流脑：脑膜空间的化脓性炎
c-h22-lg01.goal: distinguish meninges/subarachnoid pus from brain parenchyma, connect meningococcal identity/season/transmission with membrane anatomy/pathology and recognize fulminant systemic danger despite relatively mild local meningitis.
c-h22-lg01.closure: from site/pathology/systemic clues, identify meningococcal meningitis and explain why local CNS appearance cannot be used to grade systemic severity.
c-h22-lg01.continuity_rationale: KP01 is shared comparison orientation; KP02–05 close the meningococcal branch.

c-h22-lg02.label: 乙脑：脑实质变质 + 神经元/胶质反应
c-h22-lg02.goal: connect neuronal injury/liquefactive softening to sieve-like lesions, perivascular lymphocyte cuffs and astrocyte/microglia/oligodendrocyte response identities.
c-h22-lg02.closure: identify the four characteristic tissue/cell patterns on description/image and distinguish neuronophagia from satellitosis without expanding a full neurology course.
c-h22-lg02.continuity_rationale: these four KPs are one brain-parenchymal pathology model.

c-h22-lg03.label: 流脑 vs 乙脑 vs 结脑最终分流
c-h22-lg03.goal: separate membrane/purulent, parenchymal/degenerative and basal TB meningitis entries, then return detailed clinical management to the appropriate owner/Source gap.
c-h22-lg03.closure: solve a fresh CNS-infection pathology vignette while preserving H22-SC01 rather than silently rewriting the astrocyte-fiber wording conflict.

hematology-h23.title: 伤寒、细菌性痢疾与感染性肠溃疡
hematology-h23.first_pass_focus: 以部位—炎症—溃疡—并发症轴区分伤寒/菌痢并与非感染性肠病做病理比较。
hematology-h23.stop_line: 不复制B消化课程；疟疾只保留已Source支持的缺口桥。
hematology-h23.recall_spine: 肠道病理四轴 → 伤寒 → 菌痢 → 疟疾 Source Gap → 感染性/炎症性肠溃疡比较网 → 最终算法

c-h23-lg01.label: 肠道病理四轴：部位—炎症—溃疡—并发症
c-h23-lg01.goal: establish the coordinate system before disease names.
c-h23-lg01.closure: describe an unfamiliar intestinal lesion on the four axes and predict what type of narrowing/bleeding/perforation risk its structure creates.

c-h23-lg02.label: 伤寒：巨噬增生 → 平行溃疡 → 出血/穿孔
c-h23-lg02.goal: connect acute mononuclear-macrophage proliferation/typhoid nodules with terminal-ileal lymphoid structure, longitudinal ulcers, weekly stages and Source recognition signs.
c-h23-lg02.closure: derive the ulcer direction from lymphoid architecture and explain why hemorrhage/perforation rather than annular obstruction is the characteristic danger.
c-h23-lg02.continuity_rationale: these five KPs tell one typhoid pathology story; low-frequency recognition detail stays secondary.

c-h23-lg03.label: 菌痢：直乙假膜 → 浅地图溃疡；中毒性型局部轻全身重
c-h23-lg03.goal: connect rectosigmoid location, fibrinous pseudomembrane and superficial map-like ulcer to mucus/bloody stool/tenesmus, then distinguish toxic dysentery’s heavy systemic toxicity with mild local lesions.
c-h23-lg03.closure: identify ordinary vs toxic dysentery from local/systemic relationship and explain why lack of deep ulceration does not mean the systemic case is mild.
c-h23-lg03.continuity_rationale: these four KPs are one bacillary-dysentery branch with its major exception.

c-h23-lg04.label: 疟疾 Source Gap：accounted, not invented
c-h23-lg04.goal: retain only the Source-supported intermittent-fever/afebrile alternation, chronic splenomegaly and WBC-decrease interface while explicitly leaving unsupported Outline detail unresolved.
c-h23-lg04.closure: state the currently safe malaria interface and refuse to fill the missing complete disease model from memory.
c-h23-lg04.continuity_rationale: singleton Source-gap guard is preferable to contaminating another disease group.

c-h23-lg05.label: 感染性 / 炎症性肠溃疡比较网
c-h23-lg05.goal: compare TB vs typhoid structural orientation, bacillary dysentery, amoebic/interface lesions, UC/CD and upper-GI ulcer/tumor patterns by site/orientation/depth/continuity while returning full models to B owners.
c-h23-lg05.closure: identify a lesion from morphology and site, then state which disease owner must be reopened for full diagnosis/treatment.
c-h23-lg05.continuity_rationale: these KPs are explicitly comparison/ownership material rather than five new GI courses.

c-h23-lg06.label: 最终 intestinal-infection algorithm
c-h23-lg06.goal: execute site → inflammation → ulcer → complication → owner.
c-h23-lg06.closure: solve a fresh intestinal pathology vignette without using an isolated ulcer mnemonic as the whole diagnosis.

hematology-h24.title: 血吸虫病与性传播疾病
hematology-h24.first_pass_focus: 分别建立血吸虫虫卵病理、梅毒病理和STI病理识别，再以主角细胞/结构防混。
hematology-h24.stop_line: 不扩完整寄生虫/STI治疗；生殖管理归E。
hematology-h24.recall_spine: 血吸虫传播与主要损害 → 虫卵结节 → 梅毒 → HPV condyloma vs gonorrhea → 四病理主角比较 + 反向算法

c-h24-lg01.label: 血吸虫传播与“主要损害是谁”
c-h24-lg01.goal: preserve the three Source transmission conditions and distinguish cercarial/juvenile vascular-pulmonary effects from egg-mediated major tissue injury.
c-h24-lg01.closure: from exposure + tissue damage, state which parasite stage is responsible for the dominant lesion without expanding the full life cycle.
c-h24-lg01.continuity_rationale: entry and damaging stage are one upstream model.

c-h24-lg02.label: 虫卵结节：急性嗜酸反应 → 慢性假结核肉芽肿 → organ interface
c-h24-lg02.goal: reconstruct Hoeppli/eosinophilic acute lesion, organization into epithelioid/foreign-body chronic granuloma, distinguish it from TB and route colonic/hepatic consequences to B.
c-h24-lg02.closure: recognize acute vs chronic schistosomal lesions and explain the TB discriminators before running the reverse-identification chain.
c-h24-lg02.continuity_rationale: these six KPs are the complete Source-supported schistosomal pathology movie.

c-h24-lg03.label: 梅毒：血管炎 → 三期 → 树胶肿 / 巨细胞鉴别
c-h24-lg03.goal: connect obliterative endarteritis/perivascular plasma cells to stage identity, tertiary cardiovascular/neural disease, gumma morphology and Langhans-vs-foreign-body giant-cell context.
c-h24-lg03.closure: identify syphilitic pathology by vascular/plasma-cell/stage/morphology evidence and distinguish gumma from TB without adding missing serology/treatment.
c-h24-lg03.continuity_rationale: these five KPs are one Source-supported syphilis pathology model.

c-h24-lg04.label: HPV condyloma vs gonorrheal suppuration
c-h24-lg04.goal: distinguish HPV6/11 koilocytosis at moist mucocutaneous junctions from acute purulent genitourinary gonorrhea and preserve reproductive/STI treatment boundaries.
c-h24-lg04.closure: from pathology/site clues, separate the two and state what full reproductive/STI model is not owned by H24.
c-h24-lg04.continuity_rationale: two high-frequency STI pathology identities form one direct comparison without pretending they share a natural disease course.

c-h24-lg05.label: 四病理主角比较 + H24反向算法
c-h24-lg05.goal: compress schistosomal egg/eosinophil/granuloma, syphilitic vasculitis/plasma cell/gumma, HPV koilocyte and gonorrheal purulence, then route organ consequences out.
c-h24-lg05.closure: solve a fresh pathology vignette from its dominant cell/structure and stop at the correct Source boundary.
c-h24-lg05.continuity_rationale: KP16 explicitly warns there is no single natural disease course; KP17 operationalizes that comparison.

hematology-h25.title: 局部感染与源控制
hematology-h25.first_pass_focus: 用感染空间、压力、坏死和持续源决定引流/清创，尤其掌握手部深间隙。
hematology-h25.stop_line: 不扩完整抗菌药课程；手解剖只到源控制所需深度。
hematology-h25.recall_spine: 源控制原则+病原行为 → 浅部感染与timing exceptions → 甲沟/指头 → 掌深间隙/腱鞘/滑囊 → 最终算法

c-h25-lg01.label: 源控制原则 + 病原行为塑造感染空间
c-h25-lg01.goal: connect persistent source/high-pressure/necrotic space to drainage/debridement and use staphylococcal localization vs streptococcal spread as a tissue-behavior axis rather than a culture substitute.
c-h25-lg01.closure: identify when antibiotics cannot solve the mechanical/spatial failure and predict whether a lesion tends to localize or diffuse.
c-h25-lg01.continuity_rationale: source-control logic and pathogen tissue behavior are the Block’s upstream model.

c-h25-lg02.label: 浅部感染 + source-control timing exceptions
c-h25-lg02.goal: distinguish furuncle/carbuncle/cellulitis/erysipelas and special cellulitis, then derive why ordinary fluctuation timing fails in dangerous triangle, airway, hand high-pressure and nonpurulent erysipelas contexts.
c-h25-lg02.closure: from superficial infection location/boundary/purulence/danger, choose whether/when to incise and explain the exception rather than applying one universal rule.
c-h25-lg02.continuity_rationale: six KPs form the shallow-space discrimination and timing decision layer.

c-h25-lg03.label: 甲沟 / 指头：封闭指端高压决定疼痛进程与切口
c-h25-lg03.goal: trace paronychia progression to felon, interpret pain relief as possible ischemic nerve damage, and preserve Source-specific incision/anesthesia boundaries.
c-h25-lg03.closure: distinguish the two spaces, identify when decompression is urgent and explain why incision boundaries protect distal function.
c-h25-lg03.continuity_rationale: disease progression, high-pressure danger and operative boundary are one fingertip-space problem.

c-h25-lg04.label: 掌深间隙 / 腱鞘 / 滑囊：空间图决定切哪里
c-h25-lg04.goal: distinguish thenar vs midpalmar spaces, explain dorsal edema without a dorsal source, map tendon-sheath spread and protect transverse-crease/nerve/tendon boundaries.
c-h25-lg04.closure: localize a hand infection to the actual deep space and select the correct Source-bounded drainage direction rather than cutting where swelling looks largest.
c-h25-lg04.continuity_rationale: these four KPs are one anatomical routing map and require original visuals.

c-h25-lg05.label: 最终 local-infection algorithm
c-h25-lg05.goal: execute space → purulence/necrosis/pressure → immediate danger → timing → source-control action → H26 escalation.
c-h25-lg05.closure: solve a fresh local-infection case while explicitly rejecting “all red lesions get cut” and “wait for fluctuation in every hand/airway case”.

hematology-h26.title: 脓毒症
hematology-h26.first_pass_focus: 识别感染全身失控后同时推进病原证据、抗菌、源控制和灌注支持，保留历史Source口径。
hematology-h26.stop_line: 不静默导入SOFA/qSOFA/乳酸/升压药等现代指南。
hematology-h26.recall_spine: 全身失控识别 → 病原证据+抗菌/源控/灌注并行 → 最终 Source-bound algorithm

c-h26-lg01.label: 全身失控识别：高低双向 + Source病原提示
c-h26-lg01.goal: recognize escalation from infection to systemic danger using high/low temperature and WBC, perfusion/organ threat and Source-specific G−/staph/anaerobe/fungal clues without treating those clues as etiologic proof.
c-h26-lg01.closure: identify a severe-infection pattern even when fever/WBC are low and state why pathogen clues cannot replace culture/source search.
c-h26-lg01.continuity_rationale: these KPs answer “is this now dangerous systemic infection and what Source clue family is present?”

c-h26-lg02.label: 病原证据 + 三条并行行动：抗菌、源控、灌注
c-h26-lg02.goal: choose blood/local/catheter samples, interpret repeated negative cultures cautiously, start the Current Source 1-hour IV-antibiotic line, control the source and add volume/perfusion action when shock appears.
c-h26-lg02.closure: run all three treatment lines in parallel and explain which failure remains if only one or two lines are completed.
c-h26-lg02.continuity_rationale: sampling and treatment are one time-critical workflow; full hemodynamics remain B12.

c-h26-lg03.label: 最终 sepsis Source-bound algorithm
c-h26-lg03.goal: execute focus → systemic high/low → perfusion/organ → culture → antimicrobial → source control → circulation → reassessment, while preserving the historical Lecture terminology/scoring gap.
c-h26-lg03.closure: solve a fresh case without silently importing SOFA/qSOFA/lactate/pressor algorithms not owned by Current Source.
c-h26-lg03.continuity_rationale: singleton execution algorithm and historical-boundary guard.

hematology-h27.title: 破伤风与气性坏疽
hematology-h27.first_pass_focus: 从共同污染伤入口分成破伤风神经毒素与气性坏疽肌坏死两条紧急路径。
hematology-h27.stop_line: 神经细节归D；不扩完整毒素药理。
hematology-h27.recall_spine: 共同污染伤入口/分流 → 破伤风 → 气性坏疽 → 最终 contaminated-wound emergency algorithm

c-h27-lg01.label: 共同污染伤入口 + 神经毒素 vs 产气肌坏死分流
c-h27-lg01.goal: retain the shared G+/spore/anaerobic/soil/hypoxic-wound exotoxin entry, then immediately split by target: inhibitory neural circuit vs muscle/cell membrane.
c-h27-lg01.closure: from a contaminated wound, identify which downstream movie must be tested next rather than learning both as generic anaerobic infections.
c-h27-lg01.continuity_rationale: common entry and decisive branch are one orientation problem.

c-h27-lg02.label: 破伤风：逆向运输 → 去抑制 → 痉挛；免疫/清创/气道并行
c-h27-lg02.goal: connect retrograde axonal transport, Renshaw/glycine disinhibition, stimulus-triggered conscious spasms and muscle sequence to active/passive immunization, wound source control and airway protection.
c-h27-lg02.closure: reconstruct the neural chain, identify the earliest/most dangerous muscle involvement and distinguish active antibody generation from immediate neutralization of free toxin while preserving Current Source immunization/antibiotic boundaries.
c-h27-lg02.continuity_rationale: mechanism, phenotype, immunization and treatment answer one tetanus emergency model.

c-h27-lg03.label: 气性坏疽：产气肌坏死 → 失活判据 → 广泛源控制
c-h27-lg03.goal: connect toxin/cell-membrane injury to pain/swelling/gas/black-malodorous wound/hemolysis, recognize the reverse-identification cluster and use discoloration/no contraction/no bleeding to determine debridement scope.
c-h27-lg03.closure: identify gas gangrene before waiting for fluctuation/full culture and select debridement of nonviable tissue/muscle compartment or amputation according to Source boundaries.
c-h27-lg03.continuity_rationale: disease movie, recognition and source-control extent are one fast-moving tissue-failure problem.

c-h27-lg04.label: 最终 contaminated-wound emergency algorithm
c-h27-lg04.goal: choose tetanus vs gas-gangrene path, execute the distinct life-saving actions and monitor systemic toxicity/shock → H26.
c-h27-lg04.closure: solve a fresh contaminated-wound emergency without treating both branches as ordinary purulent infection.
